fleet_summary_v1.manual_inverter_command_confirmed: Whether current mapped mode and force-power feedback confirm the operator target; command confirmation does not establish actual grid export or absence of competing writers.
fleet_summary_v1.manual_inverter_hold: Whether the operator handoff currently suppresses HEO inverter reconciliation, including while its journal save is pending; unknown or untrusted handoff storage holds control closed.
fleet_summary_v1.manual_inverter_power_kw: Requested manual force power in kW; maximum export is capped by the configured inverter ceiling and mapped native bounds, Self Use or automatic-resume cleanup uses zero, and an unvalidated power target is null.
fleet_summary_v1.manual_inverter_status: Current manual admission, feedback or blocking reason, independent of the electrical ledger and hub transport acknowledgement.
fleet_summary_v1.manual_inverter_target: Retained operator target: automatic, export_max or self_use; target intent is separate from measured inverter feedback.
